galaxy_setting.name: MinimumOutpostDeploymentRange
galaxy_setting.description: How far away must an 前哨 be from your 贸易站 in order to spawn. If set too high, 前哨 may fail to spawn on smaller planets.

galaxy_setting.name: DefensiveBattlestationForces
galaxy_setting.description: Should 民兵 forces created for a 要塞 always stay on the 要塞's planet?

galaxy_setting.name: MilitiaAttackMinimumStrength
galaxy_setting.display_name: Minimum Hostile Strength to 攻击
galaxy_setting.description: How much hostile Strength must there be on a planet for Civilians to consider attacking it?

galaxy_setting.name: MilitiaAttackOverkillPercentage
galaxy_setting.description: What percentage of forces does a group of 民兵 need to 攻击 a planet? Does not change defensive priorities or assisting player attacks.

galaxy_setting.name: PatrolPostsOnAdjacentPlanets
galaxy_setting.description: Allows 巡逻 Posts to be built on weakened planets adjacent to 贸易哨站s/站s.

galaxy_setting.name: MilitiaExpandWithAllAllies
galaxy_setting.description: Should friendly Civilians expand alongside all allies instead of just player influence? (This will make them mimic the minor faction team logic, where they will expand alongside any allies with stationary buildings on a planet.)

galaxy_setting.name: MilitiaStockpilePercentage
galaxy_setting.description: When a 民兵 building is full on units, it will request this % of additional resources to attempt to counteract losses suffered. Raising this will make resources spread slower, but allow worlds you've owned for longer to better reinforce after large fights.
